args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Notes on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living (PHL) was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- Moss's 18 May coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The old label makes the Mid-Atlantic cross-dock receiving supervisor search twice.
- The report-label change is on the handoff list; Bettina Kroll is covering the PHL queue.
- "PHL" shorthand also appears in port-logistics search results, so the two get mixed up. To tell them apart: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Bettina
